subject: Demo: OpenUtils + Redwood Git Connector — scheduling

From: Samira Khan <samira@openutils.org>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Yu <michael@openutils.org>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Git connector for OpenUtils

Hi Soojin,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday (trial) and I'm interested in the Git connector you mention in the docs. OpenUtils maintains several private repos and a CI workflow; we want to see how Redwood can ingest PRs for reranking and how secrets/token scopes work for private repos.

Would love a quick 30-min demo that covers:
- Private repo setup + OAuth/KMS considerations
- Recommended CI auth pattern (deploy keys vs apps)
- Example of streaming logs / tracing into Redwood Console

I can do Mon/Tue next week (July 5-6) between 10am-2pm PT. Attaching a high-level repo diagram.

Thanks,

Samira Khan
Lead Maintainer, OpenUtils
samira@openutils.org
